_readme: Available water per metre of soil (mm/m) = 1000 x (field capacity - wilting point), from the AquaCrop soil presets (FAO AquaCrop, aquacrop python package v3.1.0, aquacrop/entities/soil.py). These are typical textbook values, not site measurements. Cross-check against FAO-56 Table 19 or OMAFRA/AAFC data if a better source is found.
